verdict.rationale: Metronome's first-party webhook setup guide documents a configured URL that receives HTTP POST callbacks when billing events occur, such as contract creation, threshold reached, or invoice finalized. That is registrable outbound HTTP delivery a programmatic consumer can receive. The evidence is a single doc excerpt with little depth. Missing for 10: documented event-type catalog and per-event subscription filtering, payload signing/verification, retry/delivery guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Metronome sends an HTTP POST request to that URL when certain events occur, such as a contract being created, a threshold being reached or an invoice being finalized.
